# Meta orders 10 gas-fired power plants for its Hyperion AI campus in rural Louisiana (Fortune, 2026-03-27)

By Jordan Blum, Energy Editor. "Meta will pay for a total of 10 gas-fired power plants—enough to power more than 5 million homes—to electrify its rapidly expanding plans for its massive AI data center complex in northeastern Louisiana, dubbed Hyperion."

## Key findings
- Meta's **Hyperion** data-center complex is under construction in **northeastern Louisiana, rural Richland Parish**.
- Meta will pay for **10 gas-fired power plants** (7 new via Entergy agreement announced Mar 27, 2026, + 3 previously approved) totaling **7.5 GW** of capacity — a 30%+ increase to Louisiana's entire grid capacity.
- The 10 plants are estimated to cost nearly **$11 billion**.
- Meta initially announced a $10B investment (Dec 2024) for a 2,250-acre campus in Richland Parish; later quietly acquired an additional 1,400 acres.
- Oct 2025: Meta entered a joint venture with Blue Owl Capital funds (up to $27B total development) to finance/build/operate Hyperion.
- The Louisiana Public Service Commission must still approve the 7 new plants.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Fortune (top-tier outlet), Energy Editor.
- Confirms **fossil-fuel (natural gas) proximity**: 10 gas-fired power plants (7.5 GW) planned for the Hyperion campus in Richland Parish, LA.
- Note: Meta Hyperion is a major AI data center, included as "major AI data centers generally" — it is NOT the model behind any Q1 AI-hip-hop artist.
